CROWN_AND_BRIDGE.name: Crown & Bridge
CROWN_AND_BRIDGE.description: Crowns, bridges, pontics, veneers, inlays and onlays.
CROWN_AND_BRIDGE.help: Crowns, bridges, veneers, inlays and onlays. Choose which sections doctors see and which are required, then add your materials and set a price per tooth.

TEMPORARY_CROWN.name: Temporary Crown
TEMPORARY_CROWN.help: Provisional crowns and bridges — identical to the Crown & Bridge form. Configure the same sections and per-material pricing.

SURGICAL_GUIDE.name: Surgical Guide
SURGICAL_GUIDE.help: Implant surgical guide (pilot drill or full protocol). In Pricing, set the per-implant price for the pilot and/or full-protocol guide and any support fees.

EVIDENT_SMILE.help: Smile-design cases with a tooth chart, materials and shade. In Fields, choose which questions the doctor answers and mark the required ones. In Pricing, add your materials and per-tooth prices (plus an optional gingival-reduction-guide fee).

CONSTRUCTIONS_ON_IMPLANTS.help: Implant-supported crowns, bridges and bar prostheses. The doctor marks implant positions on the tooth map and configures each one. In Pricing, add your implant brands, per-implant/base fees and crown materials.

MODEL.name: Print Model
MODEL.help: Printed models — study, implant or ortho. In Fields, choose which options the doctor selects and mark the required ones. In Pricing, set a single fixed price.

GINGIVAL_REDUCTION_GUIDE.help: Gingival reduction guide — a tooth map with wax-up and approval options. In Fields, choose which fields are shown and required. In Pricing, set your price.

PRINT.name: Print
PRINT.description: Printing by material and unit count.
PRINT.help: The lab lists its print materials and a per-unit price. The doctor picks a material and enters the number of units; the price is generated from that.

MILLING.name: Milling
MILLING.description: Milling by material and selected teeth.
MILLING.help: The lab lists its milling materials and a per-unit price. The doctor picks a material and selects teeth; the teeth count drives the generated price.

OTHER_CUSTOM.name: Custom Form
OTHER_CUSTOM.description: Build your own form from any questions.
OTHER_CUSTOM.help: A blank form you build yourself. Add any number of questions, pick each answer's input type (text, number, yes/no, dropdown, multiple choice, date), mark required ones, then set a fixed price.

TITANIUM_MILLING.name: Titanium Milling
TITANIUM_MILLING.help: Titanium-milled constructions — the same form as Print Model. In Fields, choose which options the doctor selects and mark the required ones. In Pricing, set a single fixed price.
